clauses.mechanism: express revocation by EO 11157 section 502; effective on signing, June 22, 1964, no effective-date wording
clauses.reason: Whole order (single operative paragraph, offsets 1992-3430 of the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10605.txt, 20 FR 2747): signed 1955-04-22; under section 301 of the Career Compensation Act of 1949, amends section 1 of Executive Order 10119 (basic allowances for subsistence) to read as a replacement section with three continuing rules: an enlisted member subsisted in kind in a mess whose duties require absence from the station during one or more meals is entitled for each such meal to a pro-rated share of the daily basic allowance for subsistence; the Secretary of Defense, the Secretary of the Treasury and the Secretary of Commerce are authorized to set the pro-rated share for each of the three daily meals, uniform for all the services concerned; and the shares for the three meals may not total more than the basic daily allowance authorized by section 301 of the 1949 Act. The introductory words perform the replacement and are not a fourth independent command. No sunset or condition ends any of the three rules. Among later orders, the number-citation scan of held texts names EO 10605 only in EO 11157.

research_rationale:
EO 10605 is a strike-and-insert or addition amendment of a pay-and-allowance regulation order. Under the strike-and-insert ruling (owner ruling 2026-10-21, option B) its clauses continue, as amended, until the parent order ends. The first held end is the express revocation by EO 11157 section 502 (signed 1964-06-22, no effective-date wording), which names this order and its parent. The 1962 title 37 recodification is disclosed as an unnamed earlier candidate that I read as restating without substantive change (Public Law 87-649 section 12). Searches: no U.S. Code or eCFR hit for this order; the OFR disposition-note search lists the chain events recorded in the dossier.

The substantive rule was carried forward by EO 11157 itself (section 301 at offsets 21120-21900 of the held EO 11157 text restates the pro-rated meal share rule, the three-Secretary authority and the cap measured against section 402 of title 37), so the rule is transferred to the replacing order; Public Law 87-649 section 14 preserves rights that matured before its effective date, which I note but do not rely on.
